effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
＜Decode ([Lv.4 or lower w/[DS] trait])＞ (When this Digimon would leave the battle area other than in battle, you may play 1 specified Digimon card from its digivolution cards without paying the cost.)
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When a Digimon attacks, by placing 1 [DS] trait Digimon card from your hand as this Digimon's bottom digivolution card, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) After, if you have 0 or less memory, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, you may change the attack target to 1 of your [DS] trait Digimon.
xros_req:
[Digivolve] Lv.4 w/[DS] trait: Cost 3 
[DNA Digivolve] Blue/Purple Lv.4 + Black/Yellow Lv.4 : Cost 0
Stack the 2 specified Digimon and digivolve unsuspended.
